effects: The signer signs an off-chain request to cancel the Flying Tulip spot order with the given orderId.
No token, ETH, allowance or session state changes on chain: the SessionManager at the deployments does not define or verify a CancelOrder type.
The message has no user, nonce or deadline, so the signature does not expire and is not bound to an account inside the message.
formats.shown: "Cancel order <orderId>" with the order ID as a raw string.

findings.title: CancelOrder binds to SessionManager, but that contract never verifies a CancelOrder signature.
findings.evidence: SessionManager.sol (both deployments) defines only _ASSET_LIMIT_TYPEHASH, _SESSION_TYPEHASH, _SESSION_CALL_TYPEHASH, _REVOKE_SESSION_TYPEHASH ("RevokeSession(bytes32 sessionId,uint256 deadline)") and _INVALIDATE_NONCE_TYPEHASH. No CancelOrder type hash exists. Descriptor domain: name "FT SessionManager", version "1", deployments 1:0xF9f3…, 146:0x109A….
findings.fix: No descriptor change. Document that an off-chain order service consumes the message under the SessionManager domain.

findings.title: CancelOrder message has no deadline or user, so the screen cannot show an expiry or an owner.
findings.evidence: Format key "CancelOrder(string orderId)" holds one member. Case 0 message: {"orderId":"ft-spot-141"}. The screen shows only 'Order ID'.
findings.fix: No descriptor change. The protocol can add a user and a deadline to the type.

findings.title: Descriptor metadata names the contract 'Spot order cancellation', but the verifying contract is SessionManager.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json metadata.contractName "Spot order cancellation"; meta.json and SessionManager.sol: contract SessionManager. The file also covers TP/SL cancellation.
findings.fix: Set contractName to "FT SessionManager" or a name that covers spot and TP/SL cancellation.

effects: The signer signs an off-chain request to cancel the take-profit/stop-loss group tpslGroupId on position positionId for account user.
The position loses its TP/SL protection once the backend processes the cancellation. Nothing in the source shows this happening on chain.
The request is valid until the deadline.
No token, ETH, allowance or session state changes on chain: the SessionManager does not define or verify a TpslGroupCancel type.
formats.shown: "Cancel TP/SL <tpslGroupId>" with the user address, position ID, TP/SL group ID and deadline as a date.

findings.title: TpslGroupCancel binds to SessionManager, but that contract never verifies a TpslGroupCancel signature.
findings.evidence: SessionManager.sol (both deployments) has no TpslGroupCancel type hash. Its only typed messages are Session, SessionCall, RevokeSession and InvalidateNonce. Descriptor domain: "FT SessionManager" version "1".
findings.fix: No descriptor change. Document that an off-chain service consumes this message.

findings.title: TpslGroupCancel interpolated intent omits the position whose TP/SL protection is removed.
findings.evidence: interpolatedIntent "Cancel TP/SL {tpslGroupId}". Case 1 renders "Cancel TP/SL tpsl-7", and 'Position ID' position-141 shows only as a field.
